(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((nines (find-color g 9))
                  (sixes (find-color g 6)))
             (if (or (null? nines) (null? sixes))
                 g
                 (let* ((p9 (first nines))
                        (p6 (first sixes))
                        (r9 (first p9))
                        (c9 (second p9))
                        (r6 (first p6))
                        (c6 (second p6))
                        (dr (- r6 r9))
                        (dc (- c6 c9))
                        (sr (if (<= (abs dr) 0) 0 (if (> dr 0) 1 -1)))
                        (sc (if (<= (abs dc) 0) 0 (if (> dc 0) 1 -1)))
                        (nr (+ r9 sr))
                        (nc (+ c9 sc)))
                   (paint-cells g (list (list r9 c9 5) (list nr nc 9) (list r6 c6 9)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((nines (find-color g 9))
                  (sixes (find-color g 6)))
             (if (or (null? nines) (null? sixes))
                 g
                 (let* ((p9 (first nines))
                        (p6 (first sixes))
                        (r9 (first p9))
                        (c9 (second p9))
                        (r6 (first p6))
                        (c6 (second p6))
                        (separator-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                          (for/and ((c (range w))) (= (at g r c) 0))) (range h)))
                        (separator-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                          (for/and ((r (range h))) (= (at g r c) 0))) (range w)))
                        (row-low (for/fold ((v -1)) ((r separator-rows))
                          (if (< r r6) (max v r) v)))
                        (row-high (for/fold ((v h)) ((r separator-rows))
                          (if (> r r6) (min v r) v)))
                        (col-low (for/fold ((v -1)) ((c separator-cols))
                          (if (< c c6) (max v c) v)))
                        (col-high (for/fold ((v w)) ((c separator-cols))
                          (if (> c c6) (min v c) v)))
                        (noise? (lambda (v) (or (= v 1) (= v 2) (= v 3) (= v 4) (= v 8))))
                        (panel-count (for*/sum ((r (range (+ row-low 1) row-high))
                                               (c (range (+ col-low 1) col-high)))
                          (if (noise? (at g r c)) 1 0)))
                        (dr (- r6 r9))
                        (dc (- c6 c9))
                        (sr (if (<= (abs dr) panel-count) 0 (if (> dr 0) 1 -1)))
                        (sc (if (<= (abs dc) panel-count) 0 (if (> dc 0) 1 -1)))
                        (nr (+ r9 sr))
                        (nc (+ c9 sc)))
                   (paint-cells g (list (list r9 c9 5) (list nr nc 9) (list r6 c6 9)))))))))
